title: Unfold triggers the signature transition (iPhone Duo, optional)
summary: Owner-selected Duo feature (candidate 2). Opening the Duo from folded to open while in the environment view triggers the shrink/diorama transition of DESIGN_SYSTEM §3, spanning the outer-to-inner display change: the room on the outer display unfolds into the tiny world. One implementation, two triggers (the unfold and the standard button on every iPhone).

acceptance_tests.test: The unfold event triggers the §3 transition exactly as specified in the locked decision text, spanning the outer-to-inner display change; closing the device reverses it or fades, as decision 3 specifies.
acceptance_tests.evidence: clip when a device or simulator is available; otherwise a design walkthrough in the PR

acceptance_tests.test: The same implementation serves the standard trigger on every iPhone; no second transition exists.
The Reduce Motion variant applies to the unfold trigger too.
A 15-second screen-recording plan for the launch video (which scan, which room, which posture sequence) is listed in the PR for M5-DUO-01.
Latency from the posture event to the first transition frame under 100 ms.
